name: Hardest Maze on Earth
author: Addicting Games
description: Hardest Maze on Earth is a free puzzle game. You have tried all of the other puzzle games. They were good, some were even great, but none of them were the hardest maze on Earth. This is the hardest maze on Earth so by definition, it is also the best maze on Earth. This maze presents itself as a series of 2-D platform levels where you must deconstruct and master the patterns of floating triangles, swinging squares, and spinning circles. Move fast, move slow, dodge the obstacles and overcome the maze. You only get one chance so failure is not an option but it is an inevitability. You may die but you can always try and die again. It is a never-ending cycle of collaboration with the game itself. If you wanna make it to the top of the leaderboard you'll have to do it by trial, error, and hard work. This is a world of puzzles and pictures. If you think your puzzle muscles are up to the challenge then this is the game for you.
